decisions.reason: Clearly distinguishes clipboard draft and occurrence offsets from detect spans, including chip expansion versus single U+FFFC and ordinary text contribution.
Locates snapshot.draft.length, explains first success on empty composer and later overshoot in detect space, and does not infer a real concurrent edit.
Traces unconverted occurrence coordinates to consumeToken, notes the false result is ignored, and ties the unavailable dock state and live chip to the same mismatch.
Derives the preceding-chip subtraction, applies it to both insert and removal with a one-character detect span, keeps revision guarding, and gates record deletion on success.
Proposes repeated paste coverage and removal with preceding or multiple chips, checking composer, dock, and records stay consistent with surviving chips.
